title: Echo 1.8.11
notes:
Show the update prompt immediately when a new version is detected.

- Removes the 15-minute wait: checks when Echo opens or returns to the foreground, then every 30 seconds while it remains open.
- A completed check triggers the popup directly, without waiting for the UI polling timer.
- Automatic checks use a lightweight public release manifest. Manual checks still use the GitHub releases API. Network speed and publication caching can affect detection.
- Update starts the download; Later still postpones that version for 24 hours. Playback continues normally.

Install 1.8.11 once using App updates or the APK to enable this behavior for subsequent releases.

Android 8.0+; package com.dev.music; version code 48; same development signing key. APK checksum is included in SHA256SUMS.txt and GitHub's asset digest.

Build succeeded. No tests were run and this release was not installed on the phone. Update manually.
